caption: The drawing depicts a single round, brown object positioned in the center of the image against a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a medallion or disc with intricate carvings on its surface. It features a symmetrical, eight-pointed star motif radiating from a central circular area, which contains an additional four-lobed geometric design. The triangular sections outside the central circle but within the star are filled with various small carved patterns, such as crescent shapes and floral-like motifs. The perimeter of the disc has a zigzag pattern encircling the entire rim. In the lower right area of the image, the name “FRITZ BOEHMER.” is printed in small, black capital letters. There are no other objects or additional colors present in this composition.
title: Zoar Buttermold
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
